title: Foundations of Screens and Devices: Protecting the Young Child from Birth
description: A parenting pathway on screens and devices from birth to age three: age-specific screen guidance, alternatives through play and direct interaction, and protecting sleep and development. It distinguishes the AAP’s 2016 statement, which makes an exception for video chatting before 18 months and allows parents who choose to introduce media at 18–24 months to use high-quality content together with their child, from WHO’s 2019 guidelines, which do not recommend sedentary screen time before age two and limit it to one hour daily at age two; less is better.

primary_reference.info: AAP: Media and Young Minds (2016), Recommendations, doi:10.1542/peds.2016-2591; WHO: Physical activity, sedentary behaviour and sleep under 5 (2019), p. 8, ISBN 9789241550536
